author: Chris Titus Tech
description:
My yearly Neovim deep dive is back — this time fully revamped for Neovim 0.12. I walk through my actual real-world workflow: pasting screenshots directly into markdown articles, yanking UUIDs from the terminal, using CopilotChat for code analysis, oil.nvim for file management, and why I still haven't ditched VS Code entirely. This isn't a "use Neovim for everything" video — it's an honest look at where it actually wins.
